description: In my role as a Teaching and Research Assistant at EURECOM, I mentor and supervise Master's students on semester and final-year projects in cybersecurity, privacy, and machine learning. I guide students throughout project design, implementation, and evaluation, monitor their research progress, and contribute to the assessment of technical reports, presentations, and project outcomes.
